row: Boundary Bay Veterinary Specialty Hospital - headquartered in Surrey, BC and with a sister hospital in Bellingham, WA - offers board-certified veterinary surgery, oncology, cardiology, neurology, internal medicine, diagnostic imaging and 24/7 emergency veterinarian critical care. As a certified VECCS Level 1 facility and a VetCOT Provisional Trauma Center, we are staffed, equipped, and trained to handle the most severe traumas and emergencies for dogs, cats and other small mammals.
